highlights.title: Simulation filtering
highlights.description: Priority and Location selections are now consistently applied to simulation input data.

highlights.title: Project Summary
highlights.description: Counts, peak hour and mapping checks now reflect only the simulated workload.

highlights.title: Simulation input files
highlights.description: Boolean configuration flags are standardized to numeric 1 / 0 values.

highlights.title: Export reliability
highlights.description: Improved validation and generation of ExtendSim input files.

details: Priority Simulation selections are applied to simulation data.
Location Simulation selections are applied to simulation data.
Excluded workload is removed from simulation input files.
Project Summary test, tube and peak-hour values use the simulated workload.
Mapping validation ignores excluded tests.
Instrument requirement checks use only simulated tests.
Priority flags are standardized to 1 / 0.
Centrifuge percentage flags are standardized to 1 / 0.
I/O Module flags are standardized to 1 / 0.
Location centrifuge flags are standardized to 1 / 0.
CentrifugePriorityFlag is automatically enabled when a simulated priority bypasses centrifugation.
Workload debugging information is hidden by default.

highlights.title: Simulation export
highlights.description: Improved ExtendSim input generation and parameter handling.

details: Added persistent More Settings for saved automation layouts.
Added Decapper percentage and tube-type exclusions.
Added Sealer percentage and tube-type exclusions.
Added RSM percentage and tube-type exclusions.
Added Aliquoter settings and tube-type exclusions.
Added SVD and USH tube exclusions.
Added I/O Module tube exclusions.
Added centrifuge percentage settings by tube type.
Improved parameter flags for More Settings.
Tube-type exclusions are converted to numeric TubeType IDs for ExtendSim.
Improved generation of simulation TXT input files.
